exposure: Self-perception of affectation of urine loss
outcome: Quality of life dimensions (mobility, anxiety/depression, health status)
cohort: The study included 381 women with a mean age of 39.9 years living in the Metropolitan Region of Chile.
finding: Women with moderate/severe urine loss frequency had a 72% greater probability of experiencing moderate/severe pain/discomfort compared to those with little or no urine loss.
